This site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and hosted on
[GitHub Pages](https://pages.github.com), deployed automatically via
[GitHub Actions](https://github.com/features/actions) on every push.
The source is public at
[github.com/pvernus/pvernus.github.io](https://github.com/pvernus/pvernus.github.io).

It has been online since May 2026.

**Privacy.** No tracking. No analytics. No cookies.

**Sustainability.** Static HTML served from GitHub's CDN. No server, no database.
